mostWorthwhile.text: Completing the vessel circuit was most worthwhile because the exchange and return diagrams connect the heart, blood and capillaries to tissue needs.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the heart and blood into the named slots was clear but predictable; each slot essentially identified its matching item.

surprise.text: I was surprised that red blood cells make ATP from sugar despite having no mitochondria. The brief explanation gives a useful contrast with muscle cells.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the item descriptions and named slots gave the combinations clear purposes.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see how the circulation supplies other tissues. The constructions made that connection interesting, though several fittings were predictable.
